sents.t: Next week is my mother’s birthday.
I buy her a gift: a coffee mug from Maple Café with a red maple leaf on it, and a small book of photos of Oakville.
I put the gifts in a box and go to the post office.
There is a long line, so I wait.
“Next!” says a woman at the counter.
“Hello. I want to send this package to my country.”
“OK. Please put it on the scale.” The box is three pounds.
I write my mother’s name and address on the form.
“Regular mail is twenty-eight dollars. It takes two or three weeks. Express mail is sixty dollars, and it takes five days.”
“Hmm. Her birthday is in eight days. Express, please.”
I also buy two postcards and some stamps.
On one postcard, I write to my grandmother: “Dear Grandma, I am happy in America. I miss you. Love, Sam.”
Then I put the postcard in the blue mailbox outside.

o: a mug and a small book of photos

comp.q: Why does Sam choose express mail?
o: The birthday is in eight days.
His mother doesn’t like regular mail.
comp.fa: چرا سام پست اکسپرس را انتخاب می‌کند؟
